canonical_prevention: Raise HTTPException with a fixed generic detail at every 500 site; log the full exception server-side with logger.error(..., exc_info=True). New 500 sites stay covered by the hermetic sanitization suite, which asserts sensitive infrastructure substrings never appear in error responses.
violated_contract: An HTTP 500 error response must never carry raw internal exception text to the client; infrastructure details (socket errors, connection strings, filesystem paths, provider API errors, key-material paths) cross the trust boundary only via server-side logs.
